name: Notion

verdict.topBlocker: Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace.
verdict.summary: Registering an OAuth app with Notion requires setting up a public connection in the Developer portal, implementing the OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant flow, and submitting for marketplace review if listing publicly.

steps.title: Create a new public connection in the Developer portal
steps.detail: Navigate to the Developer portal and create a new public connection, choosing your installation scope (Any workspace or Selected workspaces only).

steps.title: Configure OAuth redirect URIs and scopes
steps.detail: Fill out connection details including your redirect URI(s) under the OAuth configuration section. This cannot be changed after creation.

steps.title: Draft privacy policy and terms of service
steps.detail: Prepare standard legal compliance documents required for public application distribution.

steps.title: Implement OAuth authorization code flow and page picker
steps.detail: Construct the authorization URL pointing to https://api.notion.com/v1/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, and response_type=code.

steps.title: Exchange temporary authorization code for an access token
steps.detail: Make a POST request to exchange the temporary code returned by Notion for an access token and store it securely.

steps.title: Submit public connection for security review and marketplace listing
steps.detail: Manage marketplace listing details via the Listings section and submit the public connection for Notion security review.

steps.title: Await Notion marketplace and security review
steps.detail: Wait for Notion's team to complete the security review and approve the public application for the Marketplace.

requirements.note: A Notion developer account is required to access the Developer portal and create connections.
Required when publishing your application publicly or listing on the Notion Marketplace.
Public connections must undergo a Notion security review before being listed on the Marketplace.

scopes.note: All public connections follow the OAuth 2.0 protocol and require security review before marketplace publication.

blockers.symptom: Authorization URL field is missing or unpopulated in the connection settings.
blockers.cause: The Authorization URL field populates only after a public connection is submitted for review.
blockers.unblock: Submit the public connection for review in the Developer portal to generate the authorization URL.

blockers.symptom: Redirect URI mismatch errors during OAuth callback.
blockers.cause: The redirect URI used in the authorization request does not exactly match the URI configured during connection creation.
blockers.unblock: Ensure the redirect URI specified in code matches the configuration in your Developer portal settings exactly.

blockers.symptom: User cancels auth flow and application crashes or hangs.
blockers.cause: The application does not handle the OAuth error query parameter when a user presses Cancel.
blockers.unblock: Build your connection to handle the error query parameter (e.g. error=access_denied) gracefully when redirected.
